sentences.text:
The petitioners herein have invoked the extraordinary writ jurisdiction of this Court imploring for the following reliefs:-
a) Writ of Mandamus commanding the respondents more particularly respondent no.
3 to initiate process of acquisition and bring the same to its logical conclusion and in respect of the land, house, fruit bearing trees falling under Khasra No. 1785/549,
measuring 10 Kanals and on house owned and possessed by the petitioners and fruit bearing at Village Chamalwas belongs to the petitioners which has been damaged for the construction of four lanning of National Highway from Ramban to Banihal and consequently to pay the compensation to petitioners in respect of the land, house as well as the fruit bearing trees alongwith interest from the date the land, house as well as the fruit bearing trees of the petitioners has been forcibly damaged due to cutting/widening of earth till the realization and also the Jabrana as admissible under the provisions of J&K Land Acquisition Act 1990.
b) Writ of Mandamus commanding the respondents.
More particularly respondents No. 02 to 05 to pay the compensation to the petitioners for damages caused by the respondent nos. 4 & 5 while execution of the work of construction of four lanning of National Highway from Ramban to Banihal.
02.

The aforesaid reliefs are being prayed on the premise that the respondents, in the process of construction of a road, damaged the immovable property of the petitioners, consisting of a residential house, land measuring 10 Kanals and fruit-bearing trees falling under Survey No.
1775/549 situated at Village Chamalwas Tehsil Banihal District Ramban and upon agitating the grievance, the respondents 4 & 5 visited the spot and assessed the loss suffered to the aforesaid property by the petitioners, yet the respondents did not pay any compensation to the petitioners,
despite having been continuously approached in this behalf.
03.

Objections to the petition have been filed by the respondents, wherein it is being stated that the land measuring 10 Kanals covered under Survey No. 1775/529 is not the proprietary land of the petitioners and that said land is 'State Land'.

It is being admitted that the petitioners approached the Collector Land Acquisition NHAI regarding damage to their immovable property, whereupon the Tehsildar-Banihal along with field staff visited the area and found on spot that no damage had been caused to the residential house of the petitioners.

It is being also stated that the Tehsildar-Banihal,
upon making a report in the matter had stated that due to excessive rainfall or any natural calamity,
the residential house of the petitioners may suffer damage in the future and that in case a protection wall or preventive measures are taken by the construction companies, such damage can be avoided.
Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.

sentences.text: Having regard to the rival contentions of the parties raised in their respective pleadings, it is deemed appropriate to dispose of the petition with a direction to the respondents to take all necessary measures and steps those are required to be taken for protection and preservation of the residential house/s of the petitioners as the said residential houses of the petitioners as per report of the Tehsildar have become prone to damage on account of the construction of the National Highways.

Insofar as claim lodged by the petitioners qua land measuring 10 Kanals along with fruit bearing trees alleged to be owned and possessed by them is concerned, said claim is being denied by the respondents, as such, no directions in this regard are required to be passed in favour of the petitioners in the instant petition.
05. Under the aforesaid circumstances, the petition shall stand disposed of.
(JAVED IQBAL WANI) JUDGE JAMMU 13.02.2024

opennyai_summary.decision:
Having regard to the rival contentions of the parties raised in their respective pleadings, it is deemed appropriate to dispose of the petition with a direction to the respondents to take all necessary measures and steps those are required to be taken for protection and preservation of the residential house/s of the petitioners as the said residential houses of the petitioners as per report of the Tehsildar have become prone to damage on account of the construction of the National Highways.
Insofar as claim lodged by the petitioners qua land measuring 10 Kanals along with fruit bearing trees alleged to be owned and possessed by them is concerned, said claim is being denied by the respondents, as such, no directions in this regard are required to be passed in favour of the petitioners in the instant petition.
05. Under the aforesaid circumstances, the petition shall stand disposed of.
